title: Mistral's latest release of reasoning models changed prompt and output

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/mistral): add support for magistral reasoning models with thinking content type
linked_prs.body:
## background

mistral released new reasoning models (`magistral-small-2507`, `magistral-medium-2507`) that use a different output format with `thinking` content type instead of the previous `<think>` tags. this was causing `AI_TypeValidationError` when users tried to use the new models

## summary

- add thinking content type support to mistral provider schema
- add reasoning for both generate and streaming modes
- add model ids for magistral-small-2507, magistral-medium-2507, and mistral-medium-2508

## verification

- all tests pass including new reasoning content tests for generate and streaming
- reasoning content properly extracted and available via `result.reasoningText`
- streaming reasoning content emitted as real-time `reasoning-delta` events with correct timing
- examples demonstrate magistral reasoning model usage in both modes

## tasks

- [x] thinking content type added to mistralContentSchema
- [x] reasoning extraction logic in doGenerate method
- [x] reasoning extraction logic in doStream method with proper start/end events
- [x] model ids added to mistral-chat-options.ts
- [x] tests for both generate and streaming modes
- [x] examples created for reasoning model usage

closes #8012
